indicator_name: Monetary survey of the National Bank of Kazakhstan (NBK balance sheet by line)
description: Монетарный обзор Национального Банка РК (баланс НБК по статьям)
methodology: NBK formId=50, stocks at report_date, monthly from 2023-01. The API gives a mnemonic `code` with each row_code; item = row_code, Russian names read from the mnemonics and checked by the identities 1 = 1.1+1.2+1.3, 1.1 = 1.1.1+1.1.2, 2.1 = 2.1.1+2.1.2, 3 = 1+2, 3.1 = Σ3.1.x (enforced; liabilities carry a minus sign). 2 is not the sum of 2.1…2.6 (gap 0.9–6.5 trn, an unpublished line). 2.4 = NBK claims on non-bank financial institutions (KSF, Problem Loans Fund, DBK bonds) -- the NBK's quasi-fiscal channel. 3.0.a (liab_mbr) is a memo item whose exact definition is not published.
